mapper.select: SELECT place_id, place_name,COALESCE(road_address_name, address_name) AS address_name ,place_url,place_img,place_long,place_lat,place_category_detail FROM camping WHERE COALESCE(road_address_name, address_name) LIKE concat('%', #{region}, '%') order by #{sort_type} #{order} limit #{start},10

SELECT c.place_id, c.place_name, IF(c.road_address_name IS NOT NULL AND c.road_address_name != '', c.road_address_name, c.address_name) AS address_name, c.place_url, c.place_img, c.place_long, c.place_lat, c.place_category_detail FROM camping as c
ORDER BY c.place_name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci ASC DESC
LIMIT #{start}, 10
